Monument Sign FAQ

What are these monument signs made of?

They're factory-made from an engineered system of polymer-based materials. The result is a sign that's very strong but much lighter than brick, block or stone.

Can I get a different size than the one listed?

Yes. The size shown is the standard size for each style. Every style can be made in any custom size.

How are they installed?

The sign sits on two mounting poles. The poles go into post holes, and the holes are filled with concrete for stability.

Can you add my logo and lettering?

Yes. We add your logo, business name, address numbers and colors to any style. Our design team can help if you don't have artwork ready.

What areas do you serve?

We're based in Port Richey and serve Pasco County, Hernando County, Pinellas and the greater Tampa Bay area. Signs can also ship anywhere.
